items.reader_question: 被测过程经过哪些物理环节转化为可观测信号？
items.intended_insight: 说明因果链、交叉敏感和系统边界，而不是展示研究流程。
items.purpose: Explain the causal chain, observables, cross-sensitivities, and system boundary.

items.reader_question: 在统一对象、单位和条件后，代表性实验的量化结果如何比较？
items.intended_insight: 让读者直接看到差异及其可比边界，不贴入难以解码的论文截图。
items.purpose: Compare verified quantitative results only after normalizing conditions and units.

items.reader_question: 各技术路线的真实测量量、已展示能力和工程边界有何不同？
items.intended_insight: 按技术差异组织路线，不画投资门、审查门或工作流。
items.purpose: Show route differences, engineering constraints, evidence maturity, and decision boundaries.
